test_month_start_datetime: test the dt.month_start() method on a datetime Series with timezone and time unit variations
test_month_start_date: test the dt.month_start() method on a date Series to return the first day of the month
test_month_end_datetime: test the dt.month_end() method on a datetime Series with timezone and time unit variations
test_month_end_date: test the dt.month_end() method on a date Series to return the last day of the month
test_month_start_end_invalid: test that dt.month_start() and dt.month_end() raise InvalidOperationError for time dtype inputs
